t: 万道尔人国王胡内里克用阿利安人取代了尼斯内主教,并驱逐了部分主教去科西嘉.
te: King Huneric of the Vandals replaces Nicene bishops with Arian ones, and banishes some to Corsica.
dz: 万道尔人国王胡内里克用阿利安人取代了尼斯内主教,并驱逐了部分主教去科西嘉.
de: King Huneric of the Vandals replaces Nicene bishops with Arian ones, and banishes some to Corsica.

t: 罗马篡位者莱昂提乌斯被封为塔尔苏斯(现代土耳其)的东方皇帝. 他在安提俄克被承认并成为他的首都.
te: Leontius, Roman usurper, is crowned Eastern emperor at Tarsus (modern Turkey). He is recognized in Antioch and makes it…
dz: 罗马篡位者莱昂提乌斯被封为塔尔苏斯(现代土耳其)的东方皇帝. 他在安提俄克被承认并成为他的首都.
de: Leontius, Roman usurper, is crowned Eastern emperor at Tarsus (modern Turkey). He is recognized in Antioch and makes it his capital.

t: 教宗费利克斯三世将君士坦丁堡的保皇党人阿卡西乌斯驱逐出教区,支持赫诺蒂克翁,支持罢免保皇党人约…
te: Pope Felix III excommunicated patriarch Acacius of Constantinople for his support of the Henoticon and his support of t…
dz: 教宗费利克斯三世将君士坦丁堡的保皇党人阿卡西乌斯驱逐出教区,支持赫诺蒂克翁,支持罢免保皇党人约翰·塔拉亚,导致阿卡西阿斯克主义.
de: Pope Felix III excommunicated patriarch Acacius of Constantinople for his support of the Henoticon and his support of the removal of patriarch John Talaia, leading to the Acacian schism.

t: 阿利安·万达尔王国停止了对尼斯涅基督教的迫害.
te: The Arian Vandal Kingdom ceases its persecution of Nicene Christianity.
dz: 阿利安·万达尔王国停止了对尼斯涅基督教的迫害.
de: The Arian Vandal Kingdom ceases its persecution of Nicene Christianity.

dz: 阿拉里克二世继承了父亲欧里克并成为了维西哥特人的国王. 他在高卢南部的Aire-sur-l'Adour(高卢南部)建立了首都.
de: Alaric II succeeds his father Euric and becomes king of the Visigoths. He establishes his capital at Aire-sur-l'Adour (Southern Gaul).
